name: CaptchEtat
description: Provides a CAPTCHA challenge type that connects to the French government CaptchEtat API (PISTE / api.gouv.fr).
project_description: This module integrates the CaptchEtat API into Drupal, providing a distorted-text CAPTCHA (with an audio alternative) for French public-sector sites aligning with DSFR standards. CaptchEtat is delivered through the French government PISTE platform (api.gouv.fr); the module registers a 'CaptchEtat' challenge type with the contrib Captcha module, so administrators add it to forms from the Captcha points configuration page. The image and audio challenges are served through a Drupal proxy route that authenticates to the PISTE API with OAuth client-credentials, and the user's answer is validated back against the API. Requirements: the Captcha module (^2), Drupal core, and a Client ID / Client Secret obtained from PISTE (a sandbox environment is available and is the default). The 2.0.x branch integrates with the Captcha module; the older 1.0.x branch integrated with Webform. Before deploying, ensure you have registered an application on PISTE and obtained authentication credentials.
